title: Dibber 1 — repository settings (.dibber/config.json)
description: A repository's Dibber settings (SPEC.md R-DIB-14). Keys this schema does not name are allowed: they belong to a tool.

store.description: The store's folder, relative to the repository root, with no leading slash and no '..' segment.

prefix.description: The id prefix (R-DIB-4): upper-case letters and digits, starting with a letter, without the dash.

next.description: Executable and arguments that print the next ticket number.
